 8 die of dengue, 1,929 hospitalised in 24 hours
Death toll rises to 427 as cases reach 1,36,929 
 Published : 1 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 1 November 2026, 17:53
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least eight dengue patients died and 1,929 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, three were reported in Dhaka division, two in Mymensingh division, and one each in Chattogram, Rajshahi and Khulna divisions.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the total death toll rose to 427, while the cumulative number of cases reached 1,36,929.
 Currently, 6,114 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
